Question: Roy bought a new battery-gasoline hybrid car. On a trip the car ran exclusively on its battery for the first \(40\) miles, then ran exclusively on gasoline for the rest of the trip, using gasoline at a rate of \(0.02\) gallons per mile. On the whole trip he averaged \(55\) miles per gallon. How long was the trip in miles?
